title: "Pump busy" until AAPS restart
symptom: Loop reverted to default basal for hours until noticed due to UAM and high BG. A restart of AAPS immediately fixed the issue. Log indicates 'Pump is busy', as if the last command is hanging and canceled on AAPS restart. This happens frequently (2x this week).
cause: Pump stops responding. From logs, connection of Versa 2 is the reason.
fix: Add code `danaRSPlugin.disconnect("Reply not received")` at BLEComm:841 as a workaround to help AAPS recover from this situation.
evidence_quote: Pump stops responding. From logs I'd say connection of Versa 2 is the reason Best would be resolve it on Android side but as a workaround which could help AAPS recover from this situation you may try add following code: BLEComm:841 `danaRSPlugin.disconnect("Reply not received")`
